description: This unittest suite checks lexer, parser, and interpreter behavior through focused test classes.

steps.description: The test module imports unittest support and the Mini modules it checks.
TestLexer tokenizes numbers, strings, keywords, and operators, then checks that invalid input raises LexError.
TestParser checks precedence, statements, function definitions, and nested calls by inspecting parsed AST nodes.
TestInterpreter creates an interpreter and helper methods for capturing printed output or evaluating source.
Interpreter tests cover recursion, loops, closures, higher-order map, strings, runtime errors, and early returns.
Running this module directly starts unittest with verbose output.

title: Test the Mini language
